Question: Which customer is underdeveloped versus my national Flavors mix? (For example: if 25% of my nationwide sales are Flavors, but the customer Ol�mpica is only 13%.)
Query:
EVALUATE
FILTER(
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
            'Ship To'[LT1.2 - Customer],
            "Customer Flavors Mix %",
                DIVIDE(
                    CALCULATE(
                        [Unit Cases AC],
                        KEEPFILTERS('Product'[LT1.5 - Category] = "Flavors"),
                        KEEPFILTERS('Ship From'[Country] = "Colombia")
                    ),
                    CALCULATE(
                        [Unit Cases AC],
                        KEEPFILTERS('Ship From'[Country] = "Colombia")
                    )
                ),
            "National Flavors Mix %",
                DIVIDE(
                    CALCULATE(
                        [Unit Cases AC],
                        REMOVEFILTERS('Ship To'[LT1.2 - Customer]),
                        KEEPFILTERS('Product'[LT1.5 - Category] = "Flavors"),
                        KEEPFILTERS('Ship From'[Country] = "Colombia")
                    ),
                    CALCULATE(
                        [Unit Cases AC],
                        REMOVEFILTERS('Ship To'[LT1.2 - Customer]),
                        KEEPFILTERS('Ship From'[Country] = "Colombia")
                    )
                )
        ),
        "Mix Gap %",
            [Customer Flavors Mix %] - [National Flavors Mix %]
    ),
    [Customer Flavors Mix %] < [National Flavors Mix %]
)
ORDER BY [Mix Gap %] ASC
